extraction.Name: John Moses
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: No mortgage on land but borrowed money from C. E. Vandervoort, Sr.
extraction.Buyer: Land sold to Jasper Krow, for $3000.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Has any of the land been sold for debt or taxes? no
extraction.Occupation/Income: Income from Heirship land, about $25 per year. Shares in Pawnee annuity.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered 1918, Agency 4-18-18; receipted for yes; mortgage not foreclosed; no persons dependent upon the Indian for support; no property or funds accumulated; no contributions from any source except Pawnee annuity; allottee was not capable of making a good sale of his land — not acquainted with land buyers and only approached the one man who bought the land for $3000; document notarized November 26, 1928, State of Oklahoma, County of Pawnee; commission expires Jan. 31st, 1929; file no. 61391
